title: When did your hands say it all?
body: Holding the bill, passing the aux, a pinky promise at the door. Tell us a small moment where your hands did the talking.

title: Which set would your best friend pick for you?
body: Not the one you’d pick. The one they would. Burgundy-and-tortoiseshell energy, or lime-and-checks chaos? Explain yourself.

title: Your ‘haan, wohi wali’ order.
body: The one you never change. Cutting chai, cold coffee, that one momo stall. What’s the order you’ll defend forever?

title: The compliment that stayed with you.
What is your smallest friendship green flag?
body: Mine remembers the stories I never finished.

title: Splitting the bill to the last rupee: practical or a little tragic?
body: Team exact UPI split, or team “I’ll get this one, you get the next”? Pick a side and defend it.

title: Group chat drama of the week. No names, just the plot.
body: Something went down in the group chat. We don’t need to know who. Give us the plot in three lines or less.

title: Anyone else rehearse a text and still send ‘hey’?
body: Three drafts. One deleted paragraph. Final answer: “hey”. What’s the longest you’ve spent on a one-word text?
